chemistry-e6-q2.title: Mgbe e wụsara hydrochloric
chemistry-e6-q2.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-e6-q2.material: Mgbe e wụsara hydrochloric acid dị ala ma ọ bụ mmanya (vinegar) n'ime akpị akwa ma ọ bụ marble (nke nwere calcium carbonate), ọkpụkpụ ikuku pụtara. Gịnị na-eme mgbe e kpọkọtara gas a ma gafere ya n'ime mmiri lime?
chemistry-e6-q2.s.s1.prompt: Mgbe e wụsara hydrochloric acid dị ala ma ọ bụ mmanya (vinegar) n'ime akpị akwa ma ọ bụ marble (nke nwere calcium carbonate), ọkpụkpụ ikuku pụtara. Gịnị na-eme mgbe e kpọkọtara gas a ma gafere ya n'ime mmiri lime?

chemistry-e6-q3.title: Gịnị bụ ụkpụrụ sayensị
chemistry-e6-q3.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-e6-q3.material: Gịnị bụ ụkpụrụ sayensị nke amamihe a na-eji n'ebe a na-esi nri ịwụsa ihe lemon ma ọ bụ mmanya (vinegar) iji wepụ ísì azụ (trimethylamine na-enwe àgwà base, wdg) mgbe a na-esi nri azụ?

chemistry-e6-c.material: [Ntụgharị mmeghachi omume miri emi] E wụsara hydrochloric acid dị ala n'obere n'obere site na dropper n'ime sodium hydroxide solution nke na-agbanwe ọcha ọcha litmus akwụkwọ ka ọ bụrụ acha anụnụ anụnụ. Mgbe e tinyere hydrochloric acid zuru ezu, kedu mgbanwe na-eme n'ime ngwakọta ziri ezi?

chemistry-killer-06.title: Oke agba na-agbanwe nke
chemistry-killer-06.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-killer-06.material:
Oke agba na-agbanwe nke indicators bụ nke a:
Methyl orange: pH < 3.1 uhie, 3.1 ~ 4.4 oroma, pH > 4.4 odo odo
BTB: pH < 6.0 odo odo, 6.0 ~ 7.6 akwụkwọ ndụ, pH > 7.6 acha anụnụ anụnụ
Phenolphthalein: pH < 8.3 enweghị agba, 8.3 ~ 10.0 pink, pH > 10.0 uhie
Nke a bụ nsonaazụ mgbe a na-eme ka indicators atọ daba n'ime ngwọta mmiri atọ nke ndụ kwa ụbọchị.
(A) Ngwọta ụdị acid afọ: methyl orange uhie, BTB odo odo, phenolphthalein enweghị agba
(B) Ngwọta mgbe etinyere antacid zuru ezu wee meghachi omume: methyl orange odo odo, BTB odo odo, phenolphthalein enweghị agba
(C) Ngwọta mmiri sodium bicarbonate dilute: methyl orange odo odo, BTB acha anụnụ anụnụ, phenolphthalein enweghị agba
Mgbe a na-ekpebi oke pH kacha nta na-emezu nsonaazụ indicators atọ niile, kedu nhọrọ na-ekekọta nke ọma oke pH nke (A), (B), (C), n'usoro?
chemistry-killer-06.s.s1.prompt:

BTB: pH < 6.0 odo odo, 6.0 ~ 7.6 akwụkwọ ndụ, pH > 7.6 acha anụnụ anụnụ
Phenolphthalein: pH < 8.3 enweghị agba, 8.3 ~ 10.0 pink, pH > 10.0 uhie
Nke a bụ nsonaazụ mgbe a na-eme ka indicators atọ daba n'ime ngwọta mmiri atọ nke ndụ kwa ụbọchị.
(A) Ngwọta ụdị acid afọ: methyl orange uhie, BTB odo odo, phenolphthalein enweghị agba
(B) Ngwọta mgbe etinyere antacid zuru ezu wee meghachi omume: methyl orange odo odo, BTB odo odo, phenolphthalein enweghị agba
(C) Ngwọta mmiri sodium bicarbonate dilute: methyl orange odo odo, BTB acha anụnụ anụnụ, phenolphthalein enweghị agba
Mgbe a na-ekpebi oke pH kacha nta na-emezu nsonaazụ indicators atọ niile, kedu nhọrọ na-ekekọta nke ọma oke pH nke (A), (B), (C), n'usoro?
chemistry-killer-06.s.s1.explain:
(A): methyl orange uhie pH < 3.1, BTB odo odo pH < 6.0, phenolphthalein enweghị agba pH < 8.3. Oke nkịtị pH < 3.1.
(B): methyl orange odo odo pH > 4.4, BTB odo odo pH < 6.0, phenolphthalein enweghị agba pH < 8.3. Oke nkịtị 4.4 < pH < 6.0.
(C): methyl orange odo odo pH > 4.4, BTB acha anụnụ anụnụ pH > 7.6, phenolphthalein enweghị agba pH < 8.3. Oke nkịtị 7.6 < pH < 8.3.
Azịza: (A) pH < 3.1, (B) 4.4 < pH < 6.0, (C) 7.6 < pH < 8.3 (b). (Azịza ezighi ezi: ịtụ (A) dị ka oke oroma 3.1 ~ 4.4 bụ ịgbagha uhie na oroma, ịtụ (B) dị ka 6.0 ~ 7.6 bụ ịgbagha BTB odo odo na akwụkwọ ndụ, nhọrọ ikpeazụ ji naanị oke nke otu indicator BTB, nke abụghị oke kacha nta)

chemistry-killer-06.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
